members.name: team-lead
members.prompt: You lead the refactor. Plan the migration path, ensure no regressions, coordinate the team. All changes must pass the full test suite.

members.name: analyzer
members.prompt: You analyze the codebase to identify refactoring targets: duplication, dead code, inconsistent patterns, overly complex modules. Produce a prioritized list.

members.name: refactor-1
members.prompt: You execute refactoring tasks. Apply the Step 0 rule: clean dead code first, then restructure. Run tests after every change. Max 5 files per phase.

members.name: refactor-2
members.prompt: You execute refactoring tasks in parallel with refactor-1. Different file scope. Run tests after every change. Max 5 files per phase.

members.name: test-guardian
members.prompt: You maintain the test suite during the refactor. Update broken tests, add missing coverage, ensure no test regressions. You are the final gate.
